build_and_tests.portable_mirrors: CUDA source and Vulkan SPIR-V compiled

changes: Cache immutable Metal buffer metadata and avoid temporary shared ownership during validation.
Avoid redundant allocations when normalizing single-allocation dependency ranges.
Compile native pipelines with their reflected fixed threadgroup-size bound.
Keep BVH traversal counters and immutable query inputs local; initialize only live stack slots.
Compute independent soft-body covariance columns on separate native subgroups, preserving every floating-point addition order and assigning subgroup IDs without assuming lane-to-thread mapping.
Force Slang to unroll the first 32 ordered subgroup broadcasts; the prior unroll hint left a loop in generated Metal.
Parallelize independent integer radix digit prefixes with consistent CUDA/D3D12/Vulkan launch sizes and an independent native serial-prefix oracle.
